Name: Home
Title: LaunchPop tests
MetaDescription: Pages that exercise each LaunchPop setting.
ContentHTML:
Each page opens one popup. Use a normal browser window so the page can store the time and view-count limits. Read the documentation.

The page-count pages are the exception. Open Page count 1 in a fresh tab and follow its links. Visiting other pages first changes the count.

Triggers

  • Open on load — the dialog is already open.
  • Delay — it opens after 5 seconds.
  • Scroll percent — scroll about a quarter of the page.
  • Scroll to footer — the percentage is measured to the footer.
  • Scroll distance — scroll 400 pixels.
  • Exit intent — move the pointer out through the top of the window.
  • Idle — leave the pointer still for 5 seconds.
  • Any trigger — scrolling opens it, without waiting for the delay.
  • All triggers — scroll, then leave through the top. Either one alone stays closed.
  • Zero is unset — a blank delay opens on load.

Trigger modes

These set more than one trigger. Any opens on the first. All waits for every one.

  • Any: delay or exit — leaving through the top opens it before the 15 second delay.
  • Any: idle or exit — either 10 seconds still, or leaving through the top.
  • Any: distance or delay — scrolling 300 pixels opens it before 20 seconds.
  • Any of three — scroll, delay, or exit. One of them is enough.
  • All: scroll and delay — both a 15 percent scroll and 5 seconds are required.
  • All: delay and exit — leaving early stays closed. After 5 seconds you still have to leave through the top.
  • All: idle and exit — 5 seconds still, and leaving through the top, both required.
  • All: distance and delay — both 200 pixels and 5 seconds are required.
  • All of three — scroll, a 5 second delay, and exit. Two of the three stay closed.

Content

  • HTML content — the dialog body is HTML.
  • Form content — the dialog contains the subscribe form.

Limits

  • Hide on small screens — hidden at 767px and below. Widen the window and it opens.
  • Hide on large screens — hidden at 1200px and above.
  • Once per session — the first view opens it. Reload does not.
  • Shared limit, first — open this, then the next page. They share one id.
  • Shared limit, second — stays closed for 60 minutes after the first page opens.

Page count

  • Page count 1 — shows when this is the first page of the visit.
  • Page count 2 — shows only on the second page.
  • Page count 3 — shows only on the third page.

Original samples

  • Default — scroll 30 percent or exit, whichever happens first.
  • Default 2 — its delay is blank, so it opens on load.
